summary: Practise change control, payment review, claims handling, and audit-ready records for donor-funded projects. Explore the course outline.
lede: Contract administration for development-bank-financed projects helps procurement, contract, finance, and engineering teams manage obligations during delivery. Participants practise building contract registers, assessing change requests, reviewing payment evidence, and organizing claims and audit records, while aligning approvals and documentation with the applicable funder framework and signed contract.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who administer contracts or verify project decisions on donor- and development-bank-financed work. It suits teams that coordinate procurement, engineering, finance, audit, implementation, or consulting responsibilities across the contract lifecycle.
prerequisites: Prior exposure to procurement, project delivery, finance, audit, or contract administration is recommended. Bring familiarity with project documentation and basic spreadsheet use; no programming is required. Advanced contract interpretation and funder-specific implementation are addressed at an operational application level, with project procedures confirmed against the applicable financing agreement and signed contract.
